## PUCAR v1.0 — Issue Health Review (Data as of 2026-09-23)

---

### 1. Overall Health Assessment

The repository shows strong closure velocity (4,850 closed vs. 84 open) and new issues are being triaged promptly with status labels assigned. However, **56% of open issues (47/84) are stale** — a majority — indicating the team is logging work faster than it is advancing it. The pipeline is backlogged rather than blocked, which is a manageable but worsening pattern if left unaddressed.

---

### 2. Top 3 Risks

| # | Risk | Why It Matters |
|---|------|---------------|
| **1** | **Stale work accumulation (47 issues, 56%)** | Over half of all open work is idle 30+ days. This buries priority items, erodes team trust in the issue tracker, and makes capacity planning unreliable. |
| **2** | **Single showstopper open for 62 days** | Issue #5925 — duplicate payment for process/warrant — is a production financial bug in a court management system. Two months without resolution carries legal and financial exposure. |
| **3** | **Workload concentration on 3 engineers** | Sathyajith (18), Hemadri (16), and Ashish (13) hold 56% of all open issues. Any absence creates an immediate throughput bottleneck and bus-factor risk. |
